key.name: expand
key.description: Whether the applet takes up all free space along the panel (MATE_PANEL_APPLET_EXPAND_MAJOR).

key.name: color-current
key.description: Colour of the number for the workspace shown on the focused screen. A colour name or #rrggbb.

key.name: color-visible
key.description: Colour of the number for workspaces shown on other screens. A colour name or #rrggbb.

key.name: color-hidden
key.description: Colour of the number for workspaces that are not shown on any screen. A colour name or #rrggbb.

key.name: color-urgent
key.description: Colour of the number for workspaces with a window asking for attention. A colour name or #rrggbb.

key.name: bold-numbers
key.description: Whether the workspace numbers are shown in bold.

key.name: bold-title
key.description: Whether the title of the focused window is shown in bold.
